technical-summary: Expanded the Radiance bump ABI gate from kernels/ to all plugin runtime directories (kernels/, architectures/, quantizers/), verifies declared outputs in those locations, and reports runtime-relative plugin paths. Added focused ABI mismatch coverage for architecture and quantizer plugins.
